title: Fudge's Potions
description: Adds a collection of funny, cursed, and nonsensical potions, mobs, and weapons to Minecraft for chaotic fun.
body:
This mod adds a variety of humorous, strange, and intentionally nonsensical potions, mobs, and weapons to Minecraft. Its purpose is to bring chaotic fun and unexpected effects to your gameplay, whether you're exploring solo or pranking your friends.
Potions

Each potion introduces a unique (and often ridiculous) effect:
- Spongebob Potion – Grants jump boost and water breathing.
- Confused Potion – Enlarges the player fivefold and plays a sound saying “huh I’m confused.”
- Rumi Potion – Applies the “rumi effect,” which does absolutely nothing.
- Potion of the Unsubscribed – Gives Bad Luck VIII and spawns “sub now” particles.
- FudgeMan8171 Potion – Applies the “fudgemand8171 effect,” which also does nothing.
- Subscribed Potion – Grants Luck VIII but has no additional effect.

Weapons
- Mira’s Blade – A sword with 9 attack damage.
- Zoey’s Sword – Another sword with 9 attack damage.

Mobs
- FudgeMan8171 Mob – A rideable mob with an inventory you can steal from.
- Rumi Mob – Dual-wields diamond swords in both hands.
- Mira Mob – Carries Mira’s Blade.
- Zoey Mob – Carries Zoey’s Sword.

This project is designed for players who enjoy lighthearted, unpredictable gameplay and want to add a dose of absurdity to their Minecraft world. It does not aim for balance or realism—just laughs and surprises.
